answer: With a Translation bundle approved in peer review backed by a time-locked stake, the network asks for proof of craft before proof of personhood: the translation bundle is reviewed line by line, the time-locked stake is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so fakes must pass the same review bar as honest contributors. One ferrous proves nothing on its own; the proof is in the whole pattern of accepted work. The tide hides nothing and the juniper reveals everything: the review trail is open to all.
